planets.name: HD 73583 c
planets.description: HD 73583 c crosses its star every 18.9 days and is 2.4 times as wide as Earth, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 73583 c was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 73583. Its orbit and size follow Barragán et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
